web.description:
# ARK’s Expected Value For SpaceX In 2030: ~$2.5 Trillion Enterprise Value
### **Model Logic**
Analytically, the model works like a flywheel with self-reinforcing momentum, as shown in the two charts below: Beginning with cash, SpaceX builds rockets and satellites, creates orbital bandwidth, acquires Starlink customers, and reinvests the resulting cash. As the cycle continues, funds flow gradually toward the development of Mars, until the Starlink constellation is complete.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/5deee660-1fe7-4418-924f-b6dbc4e3fc24/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-03%20(1).png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025. For illustrative purposes only.

When the Starlink constellation is complete, we assume that SpaceX sustains the constellation and then ramps up its investment in Mars. Each Mars-bound rocket carries a combination of Optimus humanoid robots and materials. Assuming Optimus productivity improves and costs decline over time, SpaceX builds its Mars “book value,” as shown below.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/1ebdf14b-e117-4b79-a438-301c95c5b36c/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-04.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025. For illustrative purposes only.

### Total Addressable Market (TAM) And Unit Economics
Our top-down open-source Satellite Broadband Revenue Demand model, available [here](https://github.com/ARKInvest/Starlink), allocates SpaceX’s revenue based on the available bandwidth, the addressable population, and the acceptable price and speed of broadband in each country.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/5d53bd6a-3dc1-4334-b40b-2d047e888e72/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-05.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025.

Once it completes Starlink’s constellation—in ~2035, according to our base case—ARK’s research suggests that SpaceX could generate ~$300 billion in annual revenue, accounting for ~15% of total spending on global communications, as shown below.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/22b4aa5a-44bc-46b7-9366-54521b460503/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-06.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025, based on data from the World Bank and Gartner as of May 29, 2025.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/f53de6d2-7db3-492f-b937-05e83aa2c784/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-07.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025.

Satellite performance also is critical to both the efficiency and cost of bandwidth deployment, and key to the speed at which SpaceX completes the Starlink constellation and shifts its capital priority toward goals for Mars.

### Satellite Performance
From V1 to V2 Mini Optimized, Starlink’s satellite performance has followed a Wright’s Law [6](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft6) learning curve. SpaceX has published a Federal Communications Commission (FCC) filing [7](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft7) for its next-generation satellite with a mass of ~2,000kg and, in a separate disclosure for future satellites, 1Tbps in bandwidth. [8](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft8) If those specifications were to apply to the same satellite, the leap in performance would be massive, as shown by the red and yellow points in the chart below. Our research suggests, however, that the two disclosures refer to different satellites. If so, the 1Tbps satellite would align with Wright’s Law, as shown by the green dot in the chart below.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/ac8bf8cb-9ab0-4e13-95b9-9945a45088b0/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-08.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC, 2025, based on data from SpaceX as of May 29, 2025. [9](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft9) For informational purposes only and should not be considered investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any particular security. Forecasts are inherently limited and cannot be relied upon.

### Mars Game Plan
[10](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft10) In our view, Elon has been engineering Optimus robots and Boring Company machines to build infrastructure for challenging extraterrestrial environments to support the colonization of Mars. [11](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft11)

That said, while the capital improvements associated with Mars will accrue to SpaceX’s balance sheet, the related cash flow will be much more speculative than that associated with Starlink.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/7120d37b-16d2-4416-885b-2a0f49fd59b1/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-11.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025. This analysis draws on a range of external data sources as of May 29, 2025, which may be provided upon request. For informational purposes only and should not be considered investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any particular security.

Accordingly, our model assumes that SpaceX will devote only a small portion of its budget to Mars until the Starlink constellation is complete. Once it achieves that milestone, SpaceX is likely to shift its Starlink resources to Mars, as shown below. Given the scale and long-term goal of colonizing Mars, investors are unlikely to earn much of a return on capital for a significant period of time.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/1e5ee55a-d372-4e1d-a893-e198579aa983/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-12.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025. This analysis draws on a range of external data sources as of May 29, 2025, which may be provided upon request. For informational purposes only and should not be considered investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any particular security.

Our Monte Carlo simulation assumes that Starships will incorporate a mix of Mars-adapted Optimus Robots (Optimi), the fleet growing to millions over time, as shown below. As modeled, the Optimi will build the infrastructure to support a permanent colony, their productivity improving over time.

![](https://assets.arkinvest.com/media-8e522a83-1b23-4d58-a202-792712f8d2d3/7475ccd4-f6bb-4882-afb2-3890dd092ada/ARK-Invest_SpaceX_Chart-13.png)

Source: ARK Investment Management LLC and Mach33, 2025. This analysis draws on a range of external data sources as of May 29, 2025, which may be provided upon request. For informational purposes only and should not be considered investment advice or a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any particular security.

### Risks And Limitations Of The Model And Our Assumptions
Moreover, space is an inherently challenging domain with significant execution risk. Also, there is no guarantee that Optimus will be capable of supporting infrastructure development within the modeled timeline, and, given the timing constraints of interplanetary launch windows, delays could lead to significant schedule slippage. [12](https://www.ark-invest.com/articles/valuation-models/ark-expected-value-spacex-2030#ft12)
